description: This dataset is the City of Madison's layer of reported water main breaks, published by Madison Water Utility on the city's open data hub. The item page describes it in one line, reported water main breaks, and tags it with public works, water utility and sustainability. It is served as an ArcGIS map service layer and offered as hub downloads. The item was last modified in August 2017, so it is a historical record of break locations and not a live feed, and the item page does not list the attributes, period covered or number of breaks. Coverage: one US city's distribution network, at the level of individual break points. Access: free download and API; the licence is the City of Madison Data Policy. Caveats: sparse metadata, no stated period, and a single utility; a fuller pipe inventory is not included. It supports pipe failure and renewal-priority analysis and resilience models for drinking water networks, and relates to other break datasets from Canada that are not linked here.
